data.name: Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0 for Artemis
data.product_status: Accepted November 1982 COMDEX delivery target; release-quality demonstration and shipment acceptance are distinct gates.
data.description: Independent Autodesk CAD product for AIONix/ERA, enabled by Adam-funded whole-team development equipment, Team Edition environment and integration support.
features: Native 2D CAD with typed coordinate entry and validated numerical geometry
Explicit Logix Mouse integration and professional line/blit acceleration
Drawing exchange and supported pen-plotter output

specification.development_host: Artemis PRO with 1 MiB RAM and qualified storage; whole-team workstations plus shared server/test capacity
specification.minimum_shipping_configuration: To be measured against representative drawings; do not advertise base 128/256 KiB Artemis as qualified automatically.
specification.ownership: Autodesk retains software ownership and non-exclusive cross-platform rights.
specification.release_target: 1982-11-29; commercial shipment after acceptance, with any December fallback explicitly reported as schedule slippage, not the primary objective.
